board.title: Ticket board
board.subtitle: Triage feedback, plan tickets, track delivery
board.listAddedHint: It sits at the far right of the board.
board.loadFailed: The board could not be loaded — your session may have expired.

list.duplicatedHint: The copy sits right next to the original, with all its cards.
list.deleteConfirmWithCards: The list and its {count} ticket(s) will be permanently deleted. Move tickets you want to keep to another list first.
list.deleteConfirmEmpty: The empty list will be permanently deleted.

modal.subtitle: Ticket details
modal.label: Label
modal.unsavedText: You changed the description. Do you want to save your changes?
modal.duplicatedHint: The copy sits right below the original in the same list.
modal.linkCopiedHint: The link opens this very card — only for people with access to the board.
modal.deleteConfirmText: The ticket is deleted for good — including its checklist, attachments and history.

export.copied: Markdown copied to clipboard — ready for Claude Code.

errors.listAdd: The list was not created. Your title is still in the field — press Enter again.
errors.listRename: The new title was not saved — the list keeps its previous name.
errors.listDelete: The list was not deleted — it is still on the board with all its cards.
errors.listDuplicate: The copy was not created — nothing on the board has changed.
errors.listSort: The list was not re-sorted — the card order is unchanged.
errors.cardAdd: The card was not created. Your title is still in the field — press Enter again.
errors.save: Your change only exists in this form. Change a field again to save it — don't close the card before that.
errors.ticketDuplicate: The copy was not created — the ticket is unchanged.
errors.ticketDelete: The ticket was not deleted and is still on the board.

triage.done: AI triage added — the assessment is in the description.
triage.failed: AI triage failed — is NUXT_TICKETS_AI_KEY set?
triage.failedHint: The ticket is unchanged. Check the model id in the board settings and try again.

watch.added: You are now watching this ticket.
watch.toggleFailed: Watching was not changed — the previous state still applies.
watch.listDescription: All tickets you follow — unwatch them right here.
watch.empty: You are not watching any tickets yet.

files.title: Attachments
files.unsupported: File type not supported — allowed: images, PDF, md/txt/csv/json (max 10 MB).
files.uploadFailed: The file was not attached. Size is the most common cause (max 10 MB) — otherwise a second attempt usually works.
files.removeFailed: The attachment was not removed — it is still on this card.
files.empty: No attachments yet — images, PDF or text files (max 10 MB).

comments.title: Comments & activity
comments.notWired: Comments are not wired up in this app (override TicketModalComments).

settings.title: Board settings
settings.modelHelp: OpenRouter model id (vendor/model) — just type a custom id.
settings.savedHint: Every new AI triage will use this model from now on.
settings.invalid: Saving failed — model id in vendor/model format?
settings.invalidHint: Vendor and model, separated by a slash — e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5. Until then the previous model stays active.
settings.loadFailed: The board settings could not be loaded. Open them again — if that doesn't help, reload the page (your session may have expired).
settings.aiDisabled: AI triage is not enabled in this app (pukalani.tickets.ai).
